finalText: Verification passes. Migrated the 11 remaining app files (in `analytics`, `orders`, `billing`, `support`, `catalog`, `accounts`) from `db.query(sql, params)` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`, leaving `cache.query` calls and the vendored `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` untouched. `verify.js` confirms every call site moved and nothing else did.
